title: Patient Financial Services Policy: Basis for Re-Spreading a Patient Payment Plans Balance after an Add-On
content:
This section of the Patient Financial Services policy sets the basis on which the balance of an active Patient Payment Plans plan is spread when its installment is re-spread. The re-spread basis follows the tier and the day's add-on.

**8.1 Financial Hardship Plan.** On the Financial Hardship Plan the plan balance is spread over a fresh full term, the tier's term in months as the fee and installment schedule sets it.

**8.2 Other tiers, with an add-on on the day.** On any other tier, when an add-on is booked on the handling date and the plan shows no missed installment, the plan balance standing before that add-on is re-spread over the installments left, and the add-on together with its add-on fee is spread over the tier's full term in months as the fee and installment schedule sets it; the two spreads are added.

**8.3 Every other case.** The plan balance is re-spread over the installments left.

**8.4 Rounding.** Each spread is rounded half up to the cent.

**Terms.**

- *The day's add-on* is the add-on enrollment entries booked on the plan on the handling date; *its add-on fee* is the fee entries of the reason setup fee booked on the plan on the handling date.
- *The plan balance standing before that add-on* is the plan balance less the day's add-on and its add-on fee.
- *Installments left* are the plan's term as the plan shows it less the installments paid.
- *No missed installment* means the plan's ledger shows no installment recorded as missed.

| Tier | Add-on booked on the handling date | Missed installment on the plan | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Hardship Plan | Either | Either | Plan balance over the tier's full term |
| Any other tier | Yes | None | Balance before the add-on over the installments left, plus the add-on and its fee over the tier's full term |
| Any other tier | Yes | One or more | Plan balance over the installments left |
| Any other tier | No | Either | Plan balance over the installments left |

**Worked figure (hypothetical plan on a tier with a full term of 18).** Plan balance 2,817.90, of which the day's add-on is 687.65 and its add-on fee 24.00; 13 installments left; no missed installment.

- Balance before the add-on: 2,106.25; divided by 13 is 162.0192..., rounded to 162.02.
- Add-on and fee: 711.65; divided by 18 is 39.5361..., rounded to 39.54.
- Spread: 162.02 plus 39.54 is 201.56.

Had the plan shown a missed installment, the spread would be 2,817.90 divided by 13, 216.76.
